op shim: /root/.local/share/mise/shims/op
OK
aws shim: /root/.local/share/mise/shims/aws
OK
--- versions ---
2.38.1
aws-cli/2.36.13 Python/3.14.6 Linux/6.6.87.2-microsoft-standard-WSL2 exe/x86_64.ubuntu.22

observation.command: export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; cd /workspace && FILTER='vfox|stack|require|C\]:|crates|no field|no file|can.t load'; mise reshim 2>&1 | grep -viE "$FILTER" | tail -2; for t in op aws; do printf "%s shim: " "$t"; ls ~/.local/share/mise/shims/$t 2>/dev/null && echo OK || echo MISSING; done; echo "--- versions ---"; mise exec -- op --version 2>&1 | grep -viE "$FILTER" | tail -1; mise exec -- aws --version 2>&1 | grep -viE "$FILTER" | tail -1
